name: Muse Glimmer 30B
description: Meta's 30-billion parameter open-weight multimodal model, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic workflows; Apache 2.0 license.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer overview
sources.notes: 30B dense multimodal model (text + image input, text output), 128K default context window, Apache 2.0 license, runtimes vLLM / SGLang / llama.cpp / ExecuTorch, launch partners including Fireworks AI, Together AI, Hugging Face and Ollama.

sources.title: Meta Model API models
sources.notes: Muse Glimmer is open-weight and self-hosted; it is not served over the Meta Model API.

sources.title: Together AI available models
sources.notes: Served as meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B with a 131,072 context window.
